idea: Referral program: let existing customers invite friends by link and reward both sides with a discount on their next order.

prd.title: Customer referral program
prd.problem: Acquiring customers through paid channels is getting more expensive, while satisfied customers have no easy way to recommend the store. Marketing cannot measure word of mouth today, so it is neither encouraged nor funded.
personas: Returning customer: wants to recommend the store and be rewarded without asking support
Referred friend: wants to know the offer is real before creating an account
Program owner (marketing): wants to grow acquisition and control the cost of rewards
goals: Increase the share of new customers acquired through recommendations
Reward both the referrer and the friend in a way that is simple to understand
Keep the cost of the program predictable and resistant to abuse
success_metrics: Share of new customers acquired through referral: increase (baseline not provided)
Referral conversion rate (invited friends who place a first order): increase (baseline not provided)
Reward cost per referred customer: stay below the paid-channel acquisition cost
scope_in: Discount for the friend and credit for the referrer after the friend's first order
scope_out: Referral through social media APIs or contact import
requirements: The system must give every customer a unique referral link
The system must show the friend's discount before checkout when they arrive through a referral link
The system must credit the referrer after the friend's first order is completed
The system must let the referrer see the status of each invitation
The system must block self-referral and repeated rewards for the same friend
risks: Reward abuse by fake accounts - mitigation: reward only after a completed, paid first order
Discount cost exceeds the budget - mitigation: cap total rewards per customer per month
assumptions: Assumption: the reward is a store credit, not cash; the idea does not say which
Assumption: customers already have accounts and can sign in
open_questions: What are the reward amounts and who funds them?
What is today's acquisition cost per customer, to set the break-even point?

stories.title: Copy my referral link
stories.i_want: to copy my referral link from my account page in one step
stories.so_that: I can share it without asking support

scenarios.name: Referral link is copied for sharing
given: a returning customer is signed in
when: the customer chooses to copy their referral link
then: the link is available to paste
the link identifies the customer as the referrer

scenarios.name: Each customer has a different link
given: two returning customers are signed in

stories.title: Receive credit for a friend's first order
stories.i_want: to receive store credit when my friend completes a first order
stories.so_that: I am rewarded for recommending the store
stories.prd_ref: requirements: credit the referrer after the friend's first order

scenarios.name: Referrer is credited after the first paid order
given: a friend arrived through a customer's referral link
the friend placed and paid a first order
when: the order is marked as completed
then: the referrer receives the referral credit
the referrer is notified of the credit

scenarios.name: Credit is not given for an unpaid order
given: a friend arrived through a referral link

scenarios.name: Credit is given only once per friend
given: a referrer was already credited for a friend
when: the friend completes a second order
then: the referrer receives no additional credit

stories.title: See the friend discount from the referral link
stories.i_want: to see my discount when I arrive through a referral link and again at checkout
stories.so_that: I know the offer is real before I buy
stories.prd_ref: requirements: show the friend's discount before checkout

scenarios.name: Discount is shown on arrival
given: a visitor opens a valid referral link
then: the visitor sees the friend discount offer
the visitor sees who invited them

scenarios.name: Discount is applied at checkout
given: a visitor arrived through a valid referral link and added items to the cart
then: the discount appears as a line in the order summary

scenarios.name: Invalid link shows no discount
given: a visitor opens a referral link that does not exist
then: the visitor can still browse and buy at regular prices

stories.title: Check the status of my invitations
stories.i_want: to see whether each invited friend has registered or ordered
stories.so_that: I know when to expect my credit
stories.prd_ref: requirements: let the referrer see invitation status

scenarios.name: Referrer sees each stage
given: a customer has invited three friends, one registered and one ordered
when: the customer opens the referral page
then: the customer sees counts for invited, registered and ordered

scenarios.name: Empty state explains how to start
given: a customer has not shared the link yet
when: the customer opens the referral page
then: the customer sees how the program works and the link to copy

stories.title: Block self-referral
stories.i_want: the system to refuse rewards when the referrer and the friend are the same person
stories.so_that: reward cost is not wasted on fake referrals
stories.prd_ref: requirements: block self-referral and repeated rewards

scenarios.name: Same customer cannot reward themselves
given: a customer opens their own referral link in a new account with the same payment method
when: the new account completes a first order
then: no discount is given to the new account
no credit is given to the referrer

scenarios.name: Legitimate referral is unaffected
given: a friend with a different account and payment method arrives through a referral link
when: the friend completes a first order
then: both the discount and the credit are granted

reviews.comment: Estimable is the weakest: whether the link needs a vanity format is unclear, but this does not block sizing.
Estimable: credit timing depends on the return window, which the PRD leaves open; ask before the sprint.

Original: 'As a friend, I want a fast and nice landing experience, so that people convert' (13 points). 'Fast' and 'nice' cannot be verified and the size does not fit a sprint; rewritten around the discount the friend actually needs to see.

rewrite.title: See the friend discount from the referral link
rewrite.i_want: to see my discount when I arrive through a referral link and again at checkout
rewrite.so_that: I know the offer is real before I buy
rewrite.prd_ref: requirements: show the friend's discount before checkout

reviews.comment: Original: 'a dashboard with full referral analytics' (8 points) mixes reporting with status. Cut to the three counts the customer needs; analytics for the program owner is out of scope.

rewrite.title: Check the status of my invitations
rewrite.i_want: to see whether each invited friend has registered or ordered
rewrite.so_that: I know when to expect my credit
rewrite.prd_ref: requirements: let the referrer see invitation status

reviews.comment: Small: 5 points is the limit; the rule for 'same person' must stay minimal (payment method and device are enough for v1).
